title: Jimbob
description:
This mod adds a new formidable entity to your game, Jimbob.
Jimbob will spawn in any biome, at any time, and will chase you down nonstop until he finally can get you.
This is a horror mod.
body:
This mod adds a new formidable entity to your game, Jimbob.

Jimbob will spawn in any biome, at any time, and will chase you down nonstop until he finally can get you. Upon killing him, he will give you a diamond for defeating him.

This is a horror mod.
